description: This PHP source file defines the CorporateBrandingController class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends AbstractVueController and is responsible for setting up a Vue.js component related to corporate branding customization, including properties like allowed image types, aspect ratios, and maximum file size for uploads.

classes.name: CorporateBrandingController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering a Vue.js component related to corporate branding customization in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It prepares the component with properties like allowed image types, aspect ratios, aspect ratio tolerance, and max file size.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue.js component by adding properties related to corporate branding options, such as allowed image types, aspect ratios, and maximum upload size, before rendering.
